Unified monorepo toolchain CLI (m v0.1.0)

USAGE m lint|lint:fix|biome|typecheck|turbo|build|health|bun|test|coverage|changeset|setup|ci|ci:lint|ci:local|gitleaks|trivy|codeql|native|e2e|unocss|pages|skills|badges|docs

COMMANDS

       lint    Lint and format check (Biome, shared config)                                                                                                     
   lint:fix    Lint and format, applying safe fixes (Biome, shared config)                                                                                      
      biome    Biome with baked config path — lint and format, no root biome.json needed                                                                        
  typecheck    TypeScript wrapper — tsc owned by @myorg/tooling, use m typecheck not tsc                                                                        
      turbo    Turbo with baked root config — no root turbo.json needed, uses turbo.base.json                                                                   
      build    Bunup wrapper — bundler owned by @myorg/tooling, use m build not bunup                                                                           
     health    publint + arethetypeswrong over every publishable package                                                                                        
        bun    Bun wrapper — injects shared bunfig.toml for test, provides coverage merging                                                                     
       test    Run bun test with the shared bunfig.toml config                                                                                                  
   coverage    Coverage reporting — collect, merge, HTML, threshold check, Codecov, Pages publishing                                                            
  changeset    Changesets wrapper — init config and delegate to @changesets/cli                                                                                 
      setup    Setup CLI — regenerates lefthook.yml, installs hooks, ensures changeset config                                                                   
         ci    CI tooling for GitHub Actions — lint workflows and run locally with act                                                                          
    ci:lint    Validate workflows via actionlint with shared config                                                                                             
   ci:local    Run the push workflow locally via act                                                                                                            
   gitleaks    Gitleaks wrapper — secret scanning, defensive (skips if binary missing)                                                                          
      trivy    Trivy wrapper — vuln scanning, defensive (skips if binary missing)                                                                               
     codeql    CodeQL wrapper — info and local guidance (CodeQL runs in GitHub Actions)                                                                         
     native    Native Rust bindings via Cargo + napi-rs — one Cargo workspace in packages/native with a crate per Rust unit and an npm package per napi binding.
        e2e    Playwright E2E with browser detection — auto-skips if browsers missing, uses shared config                                                       
     unocss    UnoCSS wrapper — owns the shared config path, skips cleanly when disabled                                                                        
      pages    GitHub Pages helper — discovers declared sites, builds and stages the artifact                                                                   
     skills    AI agent skills management via skills.sh + curated skills — sync, list, add, update, validate, index                                             
     badges    Badges validation — check README badges                                                                                                          
       docs    Regenerate workflows from configs/* — static README/AGENTS with TEMPLATE-ONLY blocks                                                             

Use m <command> --help for more information about a command.

Coverage reporting — collect, merge, HTML, threshold check, Codecov, Pages publishing (mcoverage v1.0.0)

USAGE mcoverage setup|collect|html|check|pages|merge|summary|sync

COMMANDS

    setup    Install lcov/genhtml if missing (apt-get on Linux, brew on macOS)                    
  collect    Collect JS coverage (bun run coverage) + Rust coverage (mnative llvm-cov), then merge
     html    Generate HTML report via genhtml from coverage/lcov.info                             
    check    Check coverage threshold (default 80%) against coverage/lcov.info                    
    pages    Publish the HTML report into the Pages artifact dir (served at /coverage/)           
    merge    Merge per-package lcov.info reports into coverage/lcov.info                          
  summary    Show coverage summary (--json for scripts, --markdown for step summaries)            
     sync    Regenerate the root codecov.yml from the workspace package list                      

Use mcoverage <command> --help for more information about a command.

Native Rust bindings via Cargo + napi-rs — one Cargo workspace in packages/native with a crate per Rust unit and an npm package per napi binding. (mnative v1.0.0)

USAGE mnative list|matrix|add|check|clippy|fmt|fmt:check|test|build|build:release|build:ci|tree|update|doc|nextest|llvm-cov|audit|deny|typecheck|napi:build|napi:build:debug|napi:build:wasm|create-npm-dirs|artifacts|napi|sync

COMMANDS

              list    List crates and the npm packages built from them                  
            matrix    Print the CI build matrix (supported targets the packages declare)
               add    Add a crate (and, for bindings, its npm package) to the workspace 
             check    cargo check --workspace (fast type-check)                         
            clippy    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings             
               fmt    cargo fmt --all (format write)                                    
         fmt:check    cargo fmt --all -- --check (format check)                         
              test    cargo test --workspace (run Rust tests)                           
             build    cargo build --workspace (debug)                                   
     build:release    cargo build --workspace --release (lto, strip)                    
          build:ci    cargo build --workspace --profile ci                              
              tree    cargo tree (dependency tree)                                      
            update    cargo update (update dependencies)                                
               doc    cargo doc --no-deps (generate docs)                               
           nextest    cargo nextest run (faster parallel tests)                         
          llvm-cov    cargo llvm-cov --lcov (Rust coverage, requires cargo-llvm-cov)    
             audit    cargo audit (security audit)                                      
              deny    cargo deny check (license/ban check)                              
         typecheck    Type-check every npm package (skips when absent)                  
        napi:build    napi build --platform --release (one per package)                 
  napi:build:debug    napi build (debug, one per package)                               
   napi:build:wasm    napi build --target wasm32-wasip1-threads (one per package)       
   create-npm-dirs    Generate the per-platform npm packages (run in CI, not committed) 
         artifacts    Copy CI artifacts (.node/.wasm) into the npm packages             
              napi    Run napi-rs CLI (passthrough, cwd = the workspace)                
              sync    Re-sync the Turbo bridge node and Cargo→npm dependency edges      

Use mnative <command> --help for more information about a command.

AI agent skills management via skills.sh + curated skills — sync, list, add, update, validate, index (mskills v1.0.0)

USAGE mskills sync|list|ls|add|a|update|upgrade|validate|index|init|remove|rm

COMMANDS

             sync    Sync curated skills to .agents/skills/ + validate + index
         list, ls    List installed skills (curated + vendored + skills.sh)   
           add, a    Add skill via skills.sh (e.g. vercel-labs/agent-skills)  
  update, upgrade    Update skills via skills.sh                              
         validate    Validate all SKILL.md frontmatter (name, description)    
            index    Build .agents/skills.index.json                          
             init    Init new skill via skills.sh                             
       remove, rm    Remove skills via skills.sh                              

Use mskills <command> --help for more information about a command.
